# Motoph

> > Motoph covers automotive and motorcycle news, vehicle launches, dealership expansions, and community mobility solutions across the Philippines.

Motoph is a Philippine automotive and motorcycle publication featuring industry news, new vehicle releases from brands like Toyota, Honda, and Bajaj, retail store openings, and stories about vehicles serving local communities. The site focuses on both two-wheeled and four-wheeled transportation with emphasis on practical mobility solutions for Filipino riders and drivers.

## Key Topics

- Philippines automotive market
- Bajaj three-wheelers
- Bajaj Maxima Cargo
- Honda Philippines
- Toyota Motor Philippines
- Motorcycle dealerships
- Barangay patrol vehicles
- Community service vehicles
- Fuel efficiency
- Motorcycle gear and protective equipment
- Store openings and retail expansion
- South Metro Manila
- Motoworld
- REV'IT! and IXON gear
- Cargo vehicles

## Vehicle Launches and Industry News

- [Your Passions, Re-Energized: Toyota Adds New Yaris Cross SE HEV Variant to its Lineup](https://www.motoph.com/your-passions-re-energized-toyota-adds-new-yaris-cross-se-hev-variant-to-its-lineup/): Toyota Motor Philippines launches Yaris Cross SE HEV hybrid SUV variant

## Dealership and Retail Expansion

- [Honda Expands Its Reach with 800th Store, Bringing World-Class Service Closer to Filipino Communities](https://www.motoph.com/honda-expands-its-reach-with-800th-store-bringing-world-class-service-closer-to-filipino-communities/): Honda Philippines opens 800th store with Transcycle Bagac, Bataan branch
- [NEW STORE IN THE SOUTH: MotoStyle Alabang Town Center](https://www.motoph.com/?p=11801): Motoworld opens MotoStyle store at Alabang Town Center, Muntinlupa

## Community Mobility and Service Vehicles

- [Bajaj Maxima Cargo: Barangay Alabang's Trusted Partner in 24/7 Service](https://www.motoph.com/bajaj-maxima-cargo-barangay-alabangs-trusted-partner-in-24-7-service/): Barangay Alabang upgrades to Bajaj Maxima Cargo for patrol service
